Newcastle lost 4-1 at Leeds. Then 4-1 at Coventry. Jaissle's apology says it all. Rate Jaissle 1-10 👇
#Newcastle #Coventry #PremierLeague #Jaissle #Football
titulo: Newcastle lose 4-1 away again: Jaissle apologises
notas: Sky (Coventry 4-1 Newcastle, 'second consecutive away defeat 4-1', cita Jaissle literal) + Al Jazeera/Malay Mail (Leeds 4-1 Newcastle 14/09); jurado r3 8/7/6 = 7,0 (r1-2 como noticia Coventry 6,3 y 5,7: descartada); fotos Sky sin logo
